```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(nflfastR)
library(nflreadr)
```

```{r}
records <- read.csv("../../data/processed/team_records.csv")
```

```{r}
post_success <- records %>% 
  mutate(playoff_success = case_when(
    won_sb ~ 6,
    round_reached == "SB" ~ 5,
    round_reached == "CON" ~ 4,
    round_reached == "DIV" ~ 3,
    round_reached == "WC" ~ 2,
    .default = 1
  )) %>% 
  group_by(season) %>% 
  mutate(playoff_percentile = percent_rank(playoff_success)) %>% 
  select(season, team, coach, offense, defense, playoff_wins, playoff_success, playoff_percentile)
```

```{r}
write.csv(post_success, "../../data/processed/postseason_success.csv")
```
